author: Coues, 1862

note.en: A large North American gull that wanders south in winter; the only iNaturalist record in the box is from Bocas del Toro, Panama, in 2021, so it is a vagrant record only.
note.es: Una gaviota grande de Norteamérica que se desplaza al sur en invierno; el único registro de iNaturalist en la zona es de Bocas del Toro, Panamá, en 2021, así que es solo un registro de vagabundo.

evidence: iNaturalist: 1 research-grade record in the box (Bocas del Toro, Panama, 2021)

sources.t: iNaturalist taxon page and regional observations
Garrigues & Dean, The Birds of Costa Rica: A Field Guide (2nd ed., 2014), status and range

recWhy: Only an iNaturalist record in Bocas del Toro.

marks.en: Large gull with pale grey back, black wingtips with white spots and a yellow bill with a red spot.
marks.es: Gaviota grande con el dorso gris claro, puntas de las alas negras con manchas blancas y pico amarillo con una mancha roja.
